description: We are ApogeeX, a passionate group of students with a mentor, creating a record of fuel based natural disasters. Armed with open-source NASA data and a lot of caffeine, we are turning complex space data into practical, real-world solutions for our Earth.
summary: A project designed to harmonise the work of VIIRS and MODIS satellites to increase the efficiency of fuel based hot spot research
details: We aimed to bring change in the use of VIIRS and MODIS satellites by harmonising them by the use of spectral bands and five different aspect layers
